subject: Following up on the charger purchase
text:
Hi,

I hope you are doing well. I am following up on the laptop purchase your parents asked me to check last week, mainly because the store has still not confirmed whether the replacement charger will arrive before your travel dates. Since you mentioned needing the equipment by Friday, I think it may be worth calling the support line directly rather than waiting for their automated update. A colleague had a similar issue recently and found that asking for a manager or a returns specialist helped move the request along much faster.

If that feels like too much work, another practical option is to visit the branch in person with the receipt and order confirmation. Bring the damaged charger, ask them to note the original delivery promise in writing, and request either an immediate exchange or store credit. That approach often creates a clearer paper trail and may encourage staff to prioritize the matter. Before you do anything, check the warranty wording in the email confirmation and note whether the product is registered. If you prefer not to go in person, you could also ask whether a local courier or in-store pickup is available for the replacement part, since those options sometimes remain open even when the main warehouse update looks unchanged.

Let me know if you want me to draft a short message to the store for you. I am happy to help, and I hope this gets sorted without too much frustration.

Best,
Riley
